info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v5-spec
info.description: The Payment Webhook Retrieval API allows developers to access and manage webhook events related to payments. This endpoint is essential for businesses that need to monitor payment activities and respond to events in real time. Typical consumers include payment service providers, e-commerce platforms, and financial institutions looking to integrate payment notifications into their systems. By retrieving webhook data, users can ensure they are informed of transaction status updates, facilitating efficient operations and user experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve webhook information related to payment events. It is designed to provide developers with real-time updates on payment transactions and their status, enhancing the ability to respond to changes in payment states effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body should include the details of the webhook notification related to payments. It is expected to follow the structure defined in the schema, which includes necessary information for processing the webhook event.

200.description: Request completed successfully, retrieving the payment webhook data.

ListPaymentsPaymentsWebhooksRequest.description: A JSON string representation of the request body for the GET operations of the payments webhook.

status.description: Indicates the success of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the payment in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.
